description: Main-window capability, identical on macOS, Windows and Linux. Grants, each with its justification: dialog:allow-open — the folder picker (open only, no save dialogs). opener:allow-reveal-item-in-dir — 'Reveal in Finder' / 'Show in File Explorer' / 'Show in File Manager' on a scanned item; asks the OS file manager to select the item, mutates nothing. opener:allow-open-url — scoped to the x-apple.systempreferences: scheme only, used on macOS to open the Full Disk Access pane when a scan hits permission walls; no web URLs can be opened, and on Windows and Linux the UI never calls it. clipboard-manager:allow-write-text — 'Copy path', 'Copy delete command', findings exports and generated cleanup scripts put text ON the clipboard; read access is deliberately not granted. No filesystem read/write access is granted through Tauri APIs at all: filesystem READS happen only inside the app's own Rust commands, and nothing in the app can write, move, delete, or execute anything.
